title: Spherical Brownian Diffusion for Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.35101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models involve two coupled design choices: how to corrupt continuous token representations and how to invert that corruption at generation time. Recent work has explored language generation on the unit sphere through geodesic and von Mises--Fisher (vMF) paths, raising the question of which forward process to use on this geometry and how much that choice matters relative to inference. We introduce Spherical Brownian Diffusion, using Brownian motion as the canonical isotropic diffusion on the sphere. Its heat semigroup provides a principled forward process, an additive dimension-free noise clock, and an exact ancestral bridge, while a clean-token posterior learned with cross-entropy supports multiple samplers. To separate corruption from inference, we derive high-dimensional approximation rates between Brownian and moment-matched vMF corruption and use this relationship for controlled substitutions. translated_title: 用于语言建模的球面布朗扩散
translated_abstract: 连续扩散语言模型涉及两个相互耦合的设计选择：如何对连续的词元表示进行破坏，以及如何在生成时逆转这种破坏。近期工作通过测地线和von Mises–Fisher（vMF）路径探索了单位球面上的语言生成，由此引出一个问题：在这种几何结构上应使用哪种前向过程，以及相对于推理而言这一选择的影响有多大。我们提出了球面布朗扩散，将布朗运动作为球面上规范化的各向同性扩散。其热半群提供了一个有原则的前向过程、一个可加的与维度无关的噪声时钟，以及精确的祖先桥接，同时通过交叉熵学习的干净词元后验分布支持多种采样器。为了将破坏过程与推理解耦，我们推导了布朗破坏与矩匹配vMF破坏之间的高维逼近速率，并利用这一关系进行受控替换。在数独任务上，
tldr: 该论文提出球面布朗扩散，以布朗运动作为球面上规范的各向同性扩散，借助热半群构建有原则的前向过程并实现了破坏过程与推理解耦，为连续扩散语言建模提供了新的几何框架。
